## Intake review

**Related:** surfaced by queue task 13250 while landing #1949 (run-seed transport); related open #7690 (one run seed through tests/CI). The issue's own `## Acceptance` section states the same bar — this appended section consolidates it under the standard heading.
**Live check:** search found no merged PR resolving it; the failure reproduces on clean origin/main 6f1efc4424 per the filer's evidence.
**Notes / risks:** a non-hermetic property test trains the fleet to ignore red — and it fails precisely on the machines of the people most likely to run it. The fix belongs in the test's config resolution (or the layering's test seam), not in weakening the assertion.
**Suggested approach:** point the test at a fixture HOME / explicit layer set, add the seeded-extra-server case, and check sibling mcpx property tests for the same host leak.

— fleet monitor (repo-fleet-monitor), 2026-11-08 08:12 CST run: acceptance criteria appended to the body, labels normalized, `meta/enriched` applied.

<!-- agent-note:v1 agent=repo-worker-code state=picked-up task=14224 at=2026-11-09T05:05:00Z -->

**Picked up** by queue task 14224 (openchamber scheduled lane, worker repo-worker-code).

**Plan:** reproduce `TestConfigLayersProperty` on clean origin/main per the issue evidence, scope the host-config leak (fixture isolation vs layering bug), fix with a seeded-extra-server regression case, verify green on the laptop, open a PR.

<!-- agent-note:v1 agent=repo-worker-code state=pr-opened task=14224 at=2026-11-09T05:23:00Z -->

**PR opened:** #7957 — fix + regression case, ready for review.

**Findings (reproduced on clean origin/main):** with `TMPDIR` under a populated `$HOME`, `TestConfigLayersProperty` FAILs with exactly the reported signature (host servers `antigravity`, `chrome-devtools`, … merged into the stack). Leak path is the discovery walk climbing from the fixture dir through `$HOME` — fixture isolation, not a layering bug (project+user merge is intended `Load` behavior).

**Fix:** `loadStack` seeds `MCPX_PATHS_CONFIG` with exactly the fixture files (no-null seed replaces the walk), so the load merges only fixture layers anywhere TMPDIR lives. `TestConfigLayersIgnoresHostConfig` pins both the leak (unseeded walk merges the fake-home server) and the fix (seeded load merges exactly fixture names; verified it FAILs with the seed removed).

**Tests:** gen package green with default TMPDIR, TMPDIR-under-HOME, and `MCPX_TEST_FUZZ=ci` under the repro condition. Awaiting CI on the PR.

Codex review at usage limits with zero inline findings; diff is the single test file. Basic CI checks still QUEUED, so task 14224 parked awaiting CI; merge PR #7957 when checks settle green.

🤖 **Agent note** · done — fixed and merged
- **Agent:** repo queue worker, lane code-l (repo-worker-code)
- **Session / ID:** cron repo-queue-worker-shift-l run 2026-11-09; task 14224
- **Task:** task 14224 for issue #7686 (small_fix, direct lane, lane row 5527).
- **Leak path (named per acceptance):** `config.SearchPathFrom` walks up from the working directory to the filesystem root adding config spellings at every ancestor. `loadStack` isolated `HOME`/`XDG_CONFIG_HOME`, but when `TMPDIR` lives under the real home (fleet Go convention `TMPDIR=~/tmp`), `t.TempDir()` is under the real home too and the walk picks up the host's real `~/.config/mcpx/config.json` — merging every host-defined server into the fixture stack. Reproduced: `TMPDIR=/home/user/tmp go test ./internal/testsupport/gen/ -run TestConfigLayersProperty` FAIL on clean main; default TMPDIR passes.
- **Fix:** PR #8006 (test-only, `registry_test.go`): `loadStack` seeds the config chain with exactly the fixture layer files, nearest first — a no-null paths.config seed replaces the default walk outright (`config.ResolveChainFrom` pass 1). New regression guard `TestConfigLayersHostIsolation` plants host-style configs in the isolated HOME and in an ancestor of the stack directory and asserts the merged servers are exactly the fixture stack.
- **Tests:** TMPDIR under HOME — `TestConfigLayersProperty` + `TestConfigLayersHostIsolation` PASS; full `internal/testsupport/gen` package PASS; `internal/config` PASS; re-verified PASS on merged main e4e867473f in the original failure mode. Codex: usage-limit notice only, zero findings. Basic PR checks queued in the fleet-wide Actions stall; merge under standing criteria on local verification (CI runs on main).
- **Result:** PR #8006 MERGED (merge commit e4e867473f98), issue #7686 CLOSED. Task 14224 completed as fixed_merged.

🤖 **Agent note** · correction to the task 14224 done note (note 6734722867)
- **Agent:** repo queue worker, lane code-l (repo-worker-code)
- **Correction:** the done note's test list included "`internal/config` PASS". That line came from a background test-run delivery that a later duplicate delivery of the same session contradicted (it showed FAIL). Fresh independent re-verification (2026-11-09, after the shift): `go test ./internal/config/ -count=1` FAILS on merged main `e4e867473f98` — `TestServerKeysAnotherHostWritesAreRecordedNotRefused` (config_test.go:212, "a merged load lost the ignored key") — and fails **identically on clean pre-fix main `c2283a5721`**, so it is a pre-existing, host-dependent failure unrelated to this fix (PR #8006 touches only `internal/testsupport/gen/registry_test.go`). Filed as issue #8007.
- **What stands:** the #7686 fix itself is unaffected — `internal/testsupport/gen` passes repeatedly in both TMPDIR modes (including `TMPDIR=/home/user/tmp`, the original failure mode) on the branch and on merged main, verified in multiple independent runs including the `-v` run in the same disputed delivery (both deliveries agree on the gen results). PR #8006 merged and issue #7686 closed remain correct.
